_about: Settings for the stress tests (scripts/build_stress_tests.py) and the what-if panel defaults (app). Every value that is not from a cited source is marked team_assumption and is printed with its value wherever it is used. Results are stress tests and what-ifs, not forecasts.
label: stress test, not a forecast

drive_limit_min.source: plan: the 15-minute drive used for the 'outside a 15-minute drive' layer

isolated_min.source: team_assumption: an area is 'isolated' by a road closure when the shortest drive to any known site is over 45 minutes or there is no route

people_per_site.source: team_assumption: sites needed at 250 people per site, used only while site capacity is unknown

rate_sweep.source: team_assumption: range of shelter-seeking rates tested (the plan uses 3–5% likely, 11.2% observed in Maui 2023)

stay_days.source: team_assumption: stay lengths tested; floor space and toilets use the Florida DEM (2010) 72-hour factors up to 3 days and the 2-week factors beyond (applied past 14 days too, team_assumption)

charges_per_day.source: team_assumption: while the power is out, every power-dependent resident in the risk area needs one outlet (charge point) a day; an upper bound (some have batteries, generators or leave the area)

dam_rate.source: team_assumption: no published shelter-seeking rate for dam failure; the inland flooding rates are used

union_rate.source: team_assumption: a person inside two hazard footprints is counted once, at the higher of the two shelter-seeking rates

pit_unsheltered.source: team_assumption: every person counted as unsheltered in the 2026 Point-in-Time count may seek a public shelter (upper bound); Oʻahu's release gives the total only, so the total is used and labelled

people_per_trip.source: team_assumption: people per accessible vehicle trip (mixed fleet of paratransit vans and buses); the plan gives no value

rate.source: plan: the likely shelter-seeking rate for the hazard (config/planning_factors.json)

stay_days.source: plan: the 72-hour emergency shelter factors (Florida DEM 2010)

outage_days.source: plan: power outlets for power-dependent residents in shelter only (no outage beyond the shelter)

support_share.source: plan: share of people in shelter with a disability (ACS via CDC SVI, the Census areas in the risk area)
